name: Baked Cauliflower Mac and Cheese with Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 16 ounces cauliflower chopped into macaroni sized pieces
why: Sausage-forward low-carb bake: 14 oz smoked sausage over riced/chopped cauliflower bound in a cheese sauce. Published 588 cal / 10g carbs / 26g protein per serving clears the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band mid-range and hits the catalog's 25g+ protein identity. Non-starchy cauliflower base (no pasta/rice/potato) so it stays low-carb when we recompute. Casserole scales cleanly to 14 servings by weigh-and-divide. Signature ingredients map to board (cauliflower, kielbasa/smoked-turkey-sausage, heavy-cream, cream-cheese, cheddar, cajun-seasoning); only Monterey jack (1/3 cup) lacks a board home - flagged for the pricer lane.
